specification.objective: Make the #123 visual golden reproducible by running screenshot comparison only on Ubuntu with Flutter 3.47.2 pinned, while retaining functional Flutter coverage on Linux and Windows.

requirements.statement: The canonical Ubuntu golden job configures subosito/flutter-action with the exact flutter-version 3.47.2 and confirms the installed runtime with flutter --version before comparing screenshots.
The navigation visual golden test is isolated to the canonical Ubuntu job; non-golden functional Flutter tests continue to run and block CI on Ubuntu and Windows.
POLIS test.complete on Windows and the ordinary functional test job exclude only tests explicitly tagged canonical-golden; all other functional tests remain in the suite.

The four existing issue-119 screenshots remain the canonical snapshots; a snapshot changes only when a reproducible canonical Ubuntu run demonstrates a visual baseline difference and the image diff is reviewed.
A missing or incorrect Flutter pin, skipped functional suite, failed golden comparison, or failed functional test keeps CI red.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A workflow regression test detects the exact Flutter 3.47.2 pin and fails when the setup action resolves only channel stable.
The GitHub Actions Ubuntu log confirms Flutter 3.47.2 is installed and the isolated navigation golden test passes using that runtime.
Ubuntu and Windows run the non-golden functional suite, excluding only the canonical-golden tag; a functional failure on either platform fails CI.
The canonical job compares all four issue-119 snapshots; any changed snapshot is produced by the canonical run and has a reviewable image diff.
Configured POLIS test.complete, lint, build, and smoke gates pass on the resulting source; no policy gate is disabled.

invariants.statement: No application behavior, API, backend, or visual layout is changed to hide renderer differences.
Linux and Windows retain all non-golden functional tests; only explicitly tagged golden cases are excluded from those runs.
Snapshots and historical #119 evidence are not changed before a GitHub Actions Ubuntu run confirms the pinned runtime.

forbidden_states.statement: The workflow selects channel stable without an exact Flutter version for the canonical golden job.
The golden test is skipped from every CI job or is allowed to fail.
A macOS or Windows render is used to regenerate canonical Ubuntu screenshots.

inputs.statement: The existing navigation visual test and four versioned issue-119 screenshots, plus the GitHub Actions workflow and configured POLIS gates.

outputs.statement: A CI workflow with pinned canonical Ubuntu golden comparison and preserved Linux/Windows functional coverage.

failure_semantics.statement: Version-pin mismatch, setup failure, golden mismatch, functional test failure on Linux or Windows, or configured POLIS gate failure returns nonzero and blocks CI.
